description: Changes one payroll setting per call, as Payroll settings on the staff page does: providerPayFallbackPct (0 to 1), providerPayDefault ({ unit: visit or hour, cents }), or payHoursFrom (booked or approved_time_logs). Staff pay settings only; no money moves. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: update_payroll_settings
title: Change payroll settings
